profile.headline: Experienced Software Developer at Cisco
profile.summary:
Results-oriented professional with proven success developing and managing software projects in challenging, fast-paced environments. Demonstrated ability to acquire technical knowledge and skills rapidly. Innovative problem solver, able to balance the business and technical sides of a problem. Decisive and proactive leadership, negotiation and problem resolution abilities. Proven strengths in meeting goals and producing bottom line oriented team efforts through excellent interpersonal, motivational and communication skills.

Specialties: Concepts:	OOAD (UML, design patterns, refactoring), SDLC, agile software practices, real-time embedded software, internationalization

Soft skills:	Technical leadership, project management, mentoring, multi-site product development and deployment experience, self-starter

Languages: Perl, Python, C/C++, Java, XML, JavaScript, SQL, Tcl/Tk, UNIX shell

OS/Protocols:	Linux, Symbian, MeeGo, SunOS/Solaris, SIP, SS7, SMTP, SNMP, GSM, SMS, TCP/IP, UDP, RPC, CORBA, TELNET, Sockets, MS ActiveSync

positions.title: Experienced Software Development Manager
positions.description:
Hands-on development manager leading team to deliver new features and enhancements for the VOSS product, a Unified Communication Cloud Based Provisioning and Management Solution. Features include enhancements to front-end, web-based application interfaces for administrators of UC apps, web-based end-user self-service portals and the back-end framework and protocol interfaces to support these features. Coordinate delivery of new features with remote product and development teams and run bi-weekly sprints to allow requirement flexibility and drive a predictable delivery schedule.
•	Development and maintenance of the VOSS product (Perl, Python and Java code base)
•	Responsible for system analysis, design, and implementation of new features and enhancements for the VOSS product
•	Manage daily operational tasks for remote development team reporting into Capetown, South Africa

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description:
Guide multiple MeeGo and Symbian S60 Smartphone development teams to deliver email, instant messaging, sharing, and social messaging applications utilizing common, reusable middleware components. Work closely with product, project and program management, UX, and development leads to ensure timely, scalable, and extensible solutions are implemented that take embedded constraints into consideration.
•	Designed, implemented, and delivered common, platform-independent components. Focus on bearer and access point management, notification, single sign-on, logging and debug subsystems.
•	Directed cross-platform development teams to successfully design and deploy multiple releases to several mobile product families on time and on budget.
•	Achieved predictable release content and schedule by driving a rigorous, iterative development process, while ensuring appropriate, maintainable, and timely solutions for complex problems.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
Managed programs from initial concept and proposal through design, specification, development, installation, debug and final client acceptance.  Primary focus on fixed-to-mobile convergent telephony solutions deployed on Nokia handset platforms for world leading PBX vendors.
•	Directed development of PBX to Cellular, least cost routing, and VoIP over WLAN solutions.
•	Supervised staff of 12 software, integration, and test engineers through entire product life cycle.
•	Facilitated global cross-team collaboration to meet deadlines, coordinate joint design sessions, and introduce streamlined development procedures.
•	Provided technical and engineering guidance to market teams and supported client presentations and contract negotiations.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Led mobile client development team with a focus on fixed-to-mobile convergent telephony solutions. Worked closely with business cross-functional areas, external customers, local and global internal resources, and vendors as technical interface and solution architect.
•	Developed reusable voice framework from which three independent mobile PBX solutions have been successfully deployed. Improved time to market by allowing team to leverage common unit and integration test environments and complicated core call processing, licensing, OMA-DM (provisioning), database management, SIP signaling, and utility libraries. Framework allows vendors to extend core functionality through the use of plug-in extension APIs.
•	Primary technical interface for international collaborative development. Developed technical requirements, ensured project scope and business objectives were clearly documented, and negotiated stakeholder agreement.
•	Accountable for the development of project documentation for senior management and key clients to facilitate project outcomes and risk mitigation.
•	Assigned and managed appropriately skilled technical resources required for project delivery, as well as necessary subject matter experts from affected business areas.
•	Enforced the use of defined development methodologies including Scrum.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented messaging clients, maintained development schedules, scoped new features, and interfaced with QA, documentation, marketing teams, and partnering companies.
•	Supervised eight engineers for the ActiveSync PIM/Email solution.
•	Implemented the WBXML encoder/decoder, administrative logging infrastructure, user interface for settings/PIM data, localization and branding.
•	Oversaw global working group meetings for UI specification, documentation, marketing and branding.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed end-to-end (requirements acquisition, OOAD, unit/integration/system testing, deployment, maintenance) object oriented, call control processing software for a highly available soft switch.
•	Worked within a team to architect Basic Call State Machine (BCSM) for access softswitch.  Personally responsible for originating basic call model (OBCM) implementation and integration with both the service and hardware control layers. Uses C++ with embedded SQL to access the call agent database, supports high availability (HA), and uses queues for inter-process communication (IPC).
•	Designed call agent database schema and wrote provisioning scripts to insert default configuration information upon installation.
•	Designed and developed multi-threaded TCAP server to allow development of advanced telephony services including Tollfree, Local Number Portability (LNP), Callback and Caller ID.
•	Designed and implemented SNMP agent process to provision, configure and monitor the SS7 stack and call processing layer of access soft switch.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed telecommunications software for both wireless and long distance telephony solutions.
•	Supported Voicemail Management System in Japan, building strong working relationships with customer and accumulating over six months on-site presence during several product cutover periods.
•	Received U.S. Patent No. 6,108,409 for Communications System with Centralized Title Translation Table. Designed and developed this subsystem and coordinated system level integration for this feature.
•	Designed and implemented multi-threaded JAVA application to update multiple Voicemail Center nodes in parallel.

patents.title: Communications System with Centralized Title Translation Table
patents.description: AIN services include multiple SCP pairs, which can be expanded to meet increased demand. The expansion can occur without cessation in services by migrating records between SCP pairs while maintaining redundancy between the pairs. A centralized GTT maintains the GTTs distributed between multiple subsystems in the AIN system. Synchronization between mate SCPs within a pair occurs at high speed as the subscriber database is split into multiple files, each file having a separate synchronization process.
